claim: Valence has one 3-star restaurant (Pic) and two 1-star restaurants (La Cachette, Épithèque); no 2-star establishments listed.
quote: run by famous French chefs such as Anne-Sophie Pic, Baptiste Poinot, Masachi Ijichi, or the Bertrand brothers

claim: Restaurant Pic offers a 7-course menu (€310, lunch Tue–Fri) and 10-course menu (€410, Tue–Sat); wine pairings €120–540; lunch 12:00–13:00, dinner 19:00–20:15; open Jan 20–Dec 20.
quote: 7-course menu: €310 (Tue-Fri lunch only) · 10-course menu: €410 (Tue-Sat, lunch and dinner)

claim: Reservations via phone +33 (0)4 75 44 15 32 or email contact@pic-valence.com; elegant attire required, men must wear long trousers and closed-toe shoes.
quote: Elegant attire is recommended, with gentlemen kindly requested to wear long trousers and closed-toe shoes.

claim: Anne-Sophie Pic is the most-decorated female chef in the world; she is the third generation at Maison Pic following grandfather André and father Jacques; she regained three stars in 2007.
quote: Anne-Sophie Pic is a French chef who is the most decorated female chef in the world.

claim: Restaurant Pic's dining room features thick carpets, floral installations, and silver-cloche table service; front-of-house team in classic attire.
quote: An artfully lit room designed to cast light on the dishes, floral creations, a thick carpet that muffles the steps of a front-of-house team dressed in classic attire.

claim: Restaurant Pic is a member of Relais & Châteaux.
quote: Restaurant Pic | Fine dining restaurant Valence | Relais & Châteaux

claim: TripAdvisor named Restaurant Pic Best Restaurant in the World in the fine dining category in 2024.
quote: elected best restaurant in the world in 2024 by Tripadvisor in the fine dining category

claim: The Drôme department has 9 Michelin-starred restaurants in 2026; apart from Restaurant Pic (3 stars), all others hold a single star — there are no 2-star restaurants in the department.
quote: 9 tables étoilées Michelin dans la Drôme

claim: La Cachette is at 12 rue des Cévennes, 26000 Valence; hours Thu–Sat lunch 12:00–13:30 + dinner 19:45–21:30, Tue–Wed dinner only; ~40 covers; 600-reference wine list; booking via phone or ZenChef.
Chef Masashi Ijichi leads La Cachette; his wife Sachi Ijichi is pastry chef.
quote: Chef étoilé Valence · Masashi Ijichi · Restaurant La Cachette Valence

claim: La Cachette has held its Michelin star continuously since 2009.
quote: La Cachette – Valence - a MICHELIN Guide Restaurant

claim: Épithèque is at 32 Grande Rue, 26000 Valence; open Wednesday–Saturday lunch and dinner; lunch 3-course €65 (+€30 wine); dinner 5-course €95 (+€50) or 7-course €125 (+€65); phone bookings only 10:00–11:45 and 18:00–19:15.
quote: Booking window: 10:00-11:45 and 18:00-19:15 · Wednesday to Saturday, lunch and dinner service

claim: Épithèque holds one Michelin star in the 2026 Michelin Guide France.
quote: Épithèque - Valence - Un restaurant du guide MICHELIN

claim: Épithèque is located on Grande Rue in the heart of Valence's old town, with a colourful room and chestnut wood tables designed for a warmer, more proximate atmosphere.
quote: Épithèque, espace convivial et créatif de Baptiste Poinot

claim: Baptiste Poinot trained under Michel Chabran, Anne-Sophie Pic, and Joël Robuchon; renamed the restaurant from Flaveurs to Épithèque in 2025 while retaining the Michelin star.
quote: Epithèque, espace convivial et créatif de Baptiste Poinot

claim: Épithèque holds 3 toques from Gault & Millau alongside its Michelin star.

quote: Restaurant La Cachette – traditional food in Valence | Chef Masashi Ijichi | Gault&Millau
